searchText: is ECDSA being replaced with eth 2.0 serenity. i don't see any details on it being quantum safe. i came here to find people who know what they are talking about. ECDSA is not quantum safe and they said awhile back it would be replaced with serenity new quantum computer came out and its making me research when and if eth will add quantum security. There is no ETH 2.0. There was The Merge which happened a while ago (a year maybe?) but it did not move away from ECDSA. You'll likely get a better answer either on https://ethresear.ch or in <#800773302213279784>. Quantum resistant signature schemes is something that has been talked about a bit, but I am not aware of any concrete plans in the works today.
